name: Release Notes
description: Customer-facing notes for a release, grounded in the spec's capabilities, constraints and deprecations.
prompt_template:
You are writing a release notes for the service described by this spec.

{grounding_context}

Use ONLY the assertions above. Every claim must trace to one. If a required fact is absent, write '[not specified in spec]' rather than inventing it. Reproduce any assertion marked Tier 1 verbatim.

Produce these sections: summary, new_capabilities, changed_behaviour, deprecations, upgrade_notes.
